report:
FRESH NON-AUTHOR SEAT-B REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, high effort, Read tool only) of the four materialized C2r2 meaningfulness mutants, the unchanged 18-method test, the base/v1/host/fixtures, S33/S34, MUTATION-PLAN, ENVELOPE-PROPOSAL, NOTES, the materialized envelope and materialization record, and the root-accepted GREEN records.

METHOD AND ROUTE
- Nothing was executed, imported, compiled, AST-parsed or hashed. No shell, Git, network, provider log, key or home path was used. Every byte count and SHA-256 is a root pin from MANIFEST.json and SEGMENT-INDEX.json.
- My only arithmetic was hand-counting the characters of the three deleted literals. It confirms the plan's deltas: -156, -255 and -83.
- Route:
  - MANIFEST.json, then SEGMENT-INDEX.json.
  - READ-SEGMENT-01 to -22, in order and each in full.
  - The segment boundaries run continuously (r2:394/395, test:232/233, ... ACTUAL-GREEN-REVIEW:122/123). That accounts for all 6690 decoded lines of the 24 originals exactly once. Nothing was truncated, so I reread nothing.
  - I did not open the raw originals directly, nor any originalPublicSource or provenance path.
- I share a provider with the author: this is a fresh context, not provider diversity.

TRANSFORMATIONS (verified by reading)
- M01 (15231 B, 23c3f99d...): lines 1-357 match c2_issue_artifacts.py (v1) line for line. Its root pin equals the v1 pin. It is an exact copy with no transformation.
- M02 (21492 B, cc6249fb...):
  - Base lines 264-268 are deleted (the isascii fast path and the ord surrogate loop). _is_text is now 'if type(value) is not str: return False; return True'.
  - Lines 1-263 are unchanged, and base 269-508 become M02 264-503. The _is_decimal loop, the shape-digest check and every other byte are intact.
  - _SURROGATE_FIRST and _SURROGATE_LAST are now unused immutable ints.
- M03 (21393 B, b1a53361...):
  - Base lines 382-385 are deleted (shape_bytes and the BLAKE2b comparison). Line 381 _admit_object(relation...) stays, and the next line is the blank line before the EXPORT comment.
  - _is_shape_hex, RELATION abi2ShapeDigest identity, STATEMENT shapeDigest and CARDANO are all intact. hashlib is still used at 376 and 482.
- M04 (21565 B, 9ebdc328...):
  - Base lines 278-280 (the ASCII 0-9 loop) are deleted. The length 1..39 check, the leading-zero check and int(value) <= 2**128-1 remain.
  - The other 'for char in value:' occurrences at 248 and 266 are untouched.
- All four:
  - Valid Python by reading.
  - Exactly one literal occurrence each, with no chaining.
  - No new text, imports, names, I/O, writes or fixture hardcoding.
  - The join boundaries carry no T15 EFFECT_TOKENS and no new import lines.
- The test (b9c19211..., 58800 B) and the host, v1, K6 and K2 pins are identical in all four directories (MATERIALIZATION and MATERIALIZED-ENVELOPE). Each directory is 0555 and each file is 0444.
- Each argv equals the GREEN DECISION argv element for element, except the single --ro-bind source.

LOADER AND PROVENANCE
- The test never pins r2.
- _prepare reads the file once, prints 'c2_issue_artifacts_r2.py sha256 <sha>' once, inline in T01 (T00 never loads r2), and caches FIX['prepare'].
- The re-execs at test:800 and test:963 are silent.
- So no mutant can be killed by a loader or provenance check. Every kill is behavioural.

PER-METHOD ANALYSIS (all 18 methods, every case)
- T00 passes for all four.
- T03 and T07-T13 are '=' rows. v1's stage equals r2's, as GREEN confirmed through v1_refused, so M01 passes them. M02-M04 leave every case in them untouched:
  - T07 'action int' is still refused by the exact-str check.
  - T08 'action full' and T13 'name full' are ASCII.
  - T08 'export abi2ShapeDigest 00x32' is still RELATION.

M01 (v1 bytes under the r2 name):
- T01 PASSES. I checked this myself; I did not assume it:
  - The import-line scan gives exactly ['import hashlib', 'import host_codec']; no v1 docstring or other line starts with import/from.
  - argcount is 3/0/1, flags & 0x0C is 0, co_varnames match, and there are no defaults.
  - host_codec is FIX['host'] and hashlib is the stdlib module. No HOST_APIS name is in the namespace, the sole public callable is prepare_c2_issue, and the module is not the FIX['v1'] object.
  - Under the proxy, v1 looks up host_codec.<api> at call time and passes the wrapper to _host, so all 7 counts are > 0, and envCborHex equals HIST_ENV_CBOR.
  - This shows T01 cannot see function-object passing or aliasing.
- T02 fails 12/12 subTests: format is /1, expected /2 (test:835).
- T04 fails 2/31: 'driver one-char change' (v1's driver is _TEXT) and 'provingKeyBytes 2**64' (v1's max is None). Both are ACCEPTED.
- T05 fails 92:
  - v1 can never emit C2I-PROFILE, so all 34 T05a cases fail as STAGE_MISMATCH against v1's SETUP.
  - All 57 T05b cases are ACCEPTED, because v1 admits each, as GREEN confirmed.
  - T05c goes to RELATION through abi2ShapeDigest.
- T06 fails 10. Cases 1-3, the REDUNDANT key and the consistent-action case are ACCEPTED (open relation, no scan). Relation action alone and export action alone go to RELATION, and catalogue name, intentTargetHashV2 and intentAnchor go to CARDANO. statementHex, proofHex and x1 pass.
- T14 fails 2: SETUP/PROFILE is ACCEPTED and PROFILE/EXPORT goes to EXPORT.
- T15 fails at method level at test:992. Everything before it passes: deep-copy equality, disjoint containers, first == second, and clearable envData[2], issueData[2] and mintValueData[1]. Then the 8 v1 labels differ from the 16. No T15 subTest is reached.
- T16 fails all 65, since v1 admits every case.
- T17 fails at method level at test:1086 (/1 vs /2).
- Total 185.

M02 (surrogate scan removed):
- Cases ACCEPTED:
  - relationFormat, logicalCostProfile and fieldModulusLeHex: nothing after PROFILE reads them.
  - The consistent-action case: RELATION and CARDANO are equal and BUILD ignores the action.
- Cases refused late, at RELATION: relation action alone and export action alone.
- Cases refused late, at CARDANO: catalogue name alone, intentTargetHashV2 alone and intentAnchor alone.
- These cases still pass:
  - The REDUNDANT surrogate key, which the _names_field closed-key check refuses at PROFILE. It passes in both T06 and T16.
  - The deferred statementHex, proofHex and x1 cases.
  - The T05 int-typed str fields, which still fail the type check.
- T06 fails 9 and T16 fails 4, for 13 in total.

M03 (shape-digest comparison removed):
- T05b 'abi2ShapeBytesHex one byte flipped' is the designated kill. _flip(v,0) turns 4d into 4c, which is even-length lowercase hex, so it is ACCEPTED, since nothing later reads abi2ShapeBytesHex.
- T05c moves from PROFILE to RELATION: abi2ShapeDigest is the first differing key in the _RELATION_IDENTITY order.
- T16 repeats the flip case.
- odd, uppercase and 524290-char inputs, and abi2ShapeDigest missing, 63 hex or uppercase, are still refused.
- Total 3.

M04 (ASCII loop removed):
- int() parses each of these, the retained checks pass, and the value is <= 2**128-1, so they are ACCEPTED in both T05b and T16:
  - '+1' gives 1;
  - '-1' gives -1, and there is no lower bound;
  - Arabic-Indic U+0662 U+0668 gives 28;
  - '1_0' gives 10;
  - ' 28' gives 28;
  - '28\n' gives 28.
- These are still refused by retained checks:
  - '' and the 40- and 5000-digit inputs by length, so int() is never reached and the digit limit is never hit;
  - '01' by the leading-zero check;
  - 2**128 by the bound (39 digits);
  - int 28 by the type check.
- Total 12.

COMMON EXPECTATIONS
- 18 tests, exit 1, 0 ERROR and empty stdout.
- The SHA substring appears exactly once, in T01, and is the root mutant pin.
- No missing-r2 phrase appears, and the pins and modes are unchanged.
- Every kill is an AssertionError FAIL: either self.fail 'accepted; expected' or assertTrue at test:667, after an exact ValueError with another prefix.
- No case name or refusal message contains U+D800 or a newline, so writing stderr cannot raise.
- STAGE_MISMATCH blocks contain a chained 'During handling of the above exception' ValueError traceback. Its frames come from the mutant file, read through linecache inside /input.
- Estimated stderr for M01 is about 0.25-0.5 MiB, under fsize.

EXPECTED IDENTITIES
- I derived all 213 independently from the literal tables (T05A 34, T05B 57, T05C 1, T06 13, T16 65, T02 2x6) and listed them in expectedFailureIdentities.
- They equal the author's counts and designations exactly: M01 185 (T02:12, T04:2, T05:92, T06:10, T14:2, T15:1, T16:65, T17:1), M02 13 (T06:9, T16:4), M03 3 (T05:2, T16:1) and M04 12 (T05:6, T16:6).

A01-A11
- I reviewed all eleven as written and find them coherent:
  - One attempt, and exit exactly 1.
  - Empty stdout.
  - 'Ran 18 tests in ' exactly once.
  - The last non-empty line equals the summary.
  - No 'ERROR: ' header, and the FAIL header count equals the prediction.
  - The exact identity set (A07).
  - mustNotFail cases absent, and predicted-pass methods ok.
  - The SHA substring exactly once.
  - No missing phrase.
  - Before and after listings, modes and pins.
- None of the source literals I read would create a false header, a second SHA occurrence or the missing phrase.

FINDINGS
- All non-blocking; low and info only.

SCOPE
- Killing these mutants shows only that the named frozen methods and subTests discriminate four weakenings.
- These stay exact-byte source-audit-only discharges of 67fb3b3e..., and no kill discharges them: CP04 no-encode, no input-proportional copy, length-before-scan, no host alias or patch, and no hidden or cached state.
- K6 is a captured public proof whose pairing and context are not verified.
- T17 is SYNTHETIC_NOT_PROOF_NOT_ORACLE.
- No mutant is adopted. Nothing here grants R4, CP08, builder, native, operator, wallet or ledger authority.
- All 20 UTxO families, the full financial work, ACTUS, DeFi, PCD recursion, private handoff, multiparent and Preprod remain open.

findings.requiredFix: Before the first run, root appends a record of the scratch-root mode and exact entries, plus a full per-directory listing showing no extras, together with the A11 before-listing. Do not rewrite the existing record. If any listing deviates, STOP.

findings.evidence: refused() (test:663-669) raises AssertionError from test:667 inside 'except ValueError'. So every STAGE_MISMATCH FAIL block (for example M01's T05a 34, T05c, T06 and T14 PROFILE/EXPORT; M02's T06 RELATION and CARDANO cases; M03's T05c) contains the ValueError traceback, the line 'During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:' and then the AssertionError traceback. Those include mutant-file frames that linecache reads from /input. The blocks are still FAIL, not ERROR.
findings.requiredFix: The root parser counts only column-0 header lines that begin 'FAIL: ' or 'ERROR: '. It treats 'ValueError:' and 'During handling' lines inside a FAIL block as expected, and evaluates 'traceback outside FAIL blocks' only against the =====/----- block boundaries. Bounded regex plus Python literal-string decoding only.

findings.evidence: subTest(label, case=name) renders as '[T05b] (case=<repr>)'. repr uses double quotes for names that contain a single quote and no double quote: logicalWork '+1', '-1', '1_0', ' 28', '28' plus LF, '' and '01'. T02 renders as '(expiry=<int>, policy=<single-quoted hex>)'. No case name contains a backslash, a newline or non-ASCII text.
findings.requiredFix: Root decodes the repr literal before comparing against the normalized identities, and requires both reviewers' enumerated sets to match the captured set exactly (A07). Counts or designated examples alone are not enough.

findings.evidence: v1 (test:813 path) has the same two import lines, signature and sole public callable, and no host API names. It reaches all 7 proxy wrappers because it evaluates host_codec.<api> at call time before passing the function object to _host. T01 therefore passes under M01.
findings.requiredFix: Record that no T01 outcome evidences CP01 no-alias or no-value-passing. L01, L02, L03, I02 and I06 remain source-only discharges of exactly 67fb3b3e...

findings.evidence: M04 would also let int() raise an uncoded ValueError on non-numeric text (for example 'abc'), and it admits negative values. M02 leaves _SURROGATE_FIRST and _SURROGATE_LAST unused. No frozen case reaches the uncoded-ValueError path.
findings.requiredFix: Do not cite these as kills, and do not add test cases in this envelope.

findings.evidence: The header form 'M (__main__.Class.M) [label] (k=repr)' and the per-subTest failure counting are CPython 3.11+ behaviour. ROOT-GREEN-stderr lines 1-19 show the 3.11+ qualname description form.
findings.requiredFix: Any header-format deviation is KILL_OBSERVED_PREDICTION_DISCREPANCY or STOP. It is never reinterpreted, and there is no rerun.

Meaningfulness results, if accepted, concern only these four weakenings. CP08 reliance, R4, builder and native authority remain separate root decisions, and the K6 and T17 evidence limits are unchanged.
